# RocketFlag Documentation

> Docs for RocketFlag, a feature-flag service with unlimited seats, evaluations and flags at one flat
> price. Boolean flags, percentage rollouts, cohort targeting, multi-environment group flags, audit logs
> and the Caretaker stale-flag system.

## Start here
- [Quick start](https://docs.rocketflag.app/guides/quick-start/)
- [What is RocketFlag?](https://docs.rocketflag.app/intro/what-is-rocketflag/)
- [Concepts](https://docs.rocketflag.app/intro/concepts/)

## Developer reference
- [API reference](https://docs.rocketflag.app/dev/api-reference/): GET /v1/flags/{id}, unauthenticated
- [Node SDK](https://docs.rocketflag.app/dev/node-sdk/) · [React SDK](https://docs.rocketflag.app/dev/react-sdk/) · [Go SDK](https://docs.rocketflag.app/dev/go-sdk/)
- [Protected keys](https://docs.rocketflag.app/dev/protected-keys/) · [Per-environment cohorts](https://docs.rocketflag.app/dev/per-env-cohorts/)
